title: Issuance-supply calendar concentration: settlement-glut versus quiet-week conditioning on the official auction clock

blindness_declaration.law: This document is authored before anyone measures anything for this lane. It declares a mechanism, a rule FAMILY and a representation identity. It contains no outcome numbers, no price/yield signal arithmetic, no conditioning of any price series on any state, and no measurement that the D2/I stages will run. Structural facts cited here are read from committed P0/P1/P2 artifacts only.

mechanism.narrative: US Treasury primary dealers are obligated counterparties of the official financing calendar: they must bid in every auction and absorb their pro-rata share of each security offered, and they can neither refuse nor re-time that obligation. Issuance is not spread evenly over calendar weeks: bill cycles and coupon cycles cluster, so some settlement weeks concentrate many dated supply commitments while neighbouring weeks are quiet. In a settlement-glut week the dealer's aggregate warehouse of newly absorbed supply peaks inside a finite balance-sheet and risk-limit envelope, so the hedging that the obligation forces must be pushed into the surrounding market BEFORE the settlement dates, when the dealer has the least discretion. In quiet weeks the same participant is unconstrained. The proposal conditions exclusively on the official announcement calendar: for each decision instant, the concentration state is a count of auction events whose official issue (settlement) dates fall inside a fixed window around that instant, derived by pure date arithmetic from the PIT census fields. No yield, no price and no policy-release content enters the state. The state is known to every participant weeks in advance: it is supply mechanics, not news.

forced_participant.who: the primary dealer carrying the auction underwriting obligation
forced_participant.why_forced: obligated to bid and absorb pro-rata supply at each auction; cannot refuse or re-time; when settlement commitments concentrate, risk limits force pre-settlement hedging into the market rather than at the auction
forced_participant.late_participant: index-tracking and mandate-bound funds that adjust holdings only at period boundaries after settlement weights change; they absorb the dealer's forced hedge with a lag

mechanism.information_source: official Treasury auction announcement calendar only (PIT census fields: announcementDate, auctionDate, issueDate, securityType, securityTerm, cusip); no prices, no yields, no survey or consensus data
mechanism.state_definition_symbolic: concentration bucket b(t) = f(count of census events with issueDate inside a fixed k1/k2 business-day window around decision session t, possibly crossed with securityType mix); k1, k2 and the bucket cuts are SYMBOLIC here and freeze at D2/S selection, never after

decision_rule_family: event-window position with state-conditioned direction by frozen sign convention; state = issuance-supply concentration bucket of the decision instant's settlement week, derived from the committed PIT auction census; executed on the frozen ETP leg set; holding = fixed event window symbolic until D2/S; direction sign and all thresholds frozen at selection, never tuned after any measurement

ancestry_risk_statement.declaration: This proposal names the pooled kill-candidate shadows it must be novel against (plan section 1; D2 pooled |rho| screen) and states, per shadow, why its information differs. This is the claim D2 will test; if any claim is false, the proposal dies at D2 by the screen or by its own battery.

named_kill_candidates.shadow: DGS10-level nominal-exposure forms (falsification-by-control #14 FX-V8; #15 FOREX-NG1 CTL-DGS10LEVEL)
named_kill_candidates.why_different: the conditioning state is a COUNT of dated official supply commitments in a settlement window, computable from the announcement calendar before any yield observation and independent of the yield level; nothing in the state is a level, a level change, or a level-contingent quantity. Honest admission: if in-sample the concentration bucket turns out to proxy a seasonal yield-level drift, that is exactly the DGS10-level control class in the D2 veto set plus the A5-family decomposition control, and the proposal dies

those forms trade the market's DIRECTION OF REACTION to a release with unknown content at a fixed clock time; here there is no release surprise at all: the auction calendar is pre-announced, content-free supply mechanics, and the decision instants are the P2 grid closes, not a reaction window around a release

momentum_63s is a time-series price-momentum clock; this proposal's state is a cross-sectional calendar count with no price input whatsoever at declaration time, and the momentum_63s form sits in the D2 pooled novelty veto set

generic_dow_tue is a bare weekday clock; the state here is event-derived from official announcements (settlement-date concentration), not a fixed weekday grid; the clock-only shadow arm in the battery is the designated executioner if the bare calendar explains everything

arms.name: bare auction-clock shadow
arms.spec: identical event windows and holding, fixed direction sign, NO concentration state (all eligible events pooled)
arms.kill_semantics: DESIGNATED KILLER: if the bare calendar out-earns the anchor, the state adds nothing over a generic event clock (generic_dow_tue / momentum_63s class) and the proposal dies

arms.name: shifted-calendar placebo
arms.spec: the identical state machinery evaluated on the auction calendar shifted by a fixed offset (symbolic N, frozen at selection, chosen to break settlement-week alignment without creating a new one)
arms.kill_semantics: DESIGNATED KILLER: if the placebo out-earns the anchor, the effect is calendar-structure-independent and the proposal dies

falsification_rule.statement: KILL if, at D2/I on the identical bookable grid and window under the identical frozen cost treatment, EITHER designated KILLER control (the shifted-calendar placebo or the bare auction-clock shadow) earns a strictly greater after-cost per-decision edge than the concentration-conditioned ANCHOR arm. A placebo matching the anchor means the effect is calendar-structure-independent; a clock-only shadow matching the anchor means the concentration state adds nothing over a generic event clock. Declared now, outcome-blind; measurable later from the committed arms alone.
